paragraphs: So they were called: R' Yose ben ha-Meshullam and R' Shimon ben Menasya, in the Yerushalmi, Maaser Sheni, chapter 2, halakhah 4; see their entries.[^1][^2]

notes.text: מע״ש is contextually Maaser Sheni, with explicit Jerusalem Talmud 2h 4; machine ה״ר differs from supplied ה״ד, without fresh image adjudication or verified modern correspondence.

The heading is the antecedent of so they were called and is a collective designation for the two named people. See their entries remains a cross-reference, not an identity/title binding. Both personal titles remain R'; ha-Meshullam’s supplied article is preserved.
